question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "wink."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason to use **"wink" **in the blank is that a **"wink"** is a gesture often associated with flirting or indicating that the party is joking. (रिक्त स्थान में **"wink"** का उपयोग करने का कारण यह है कि "wink" एक इशारा है जो अक्सर छेड़खानी से जुड़ा होता है या यह दर्शाता है कि पार्टी मजाक कर रही है।)
 
• A wink involves closing one eye briefly and is commonly used to convey a subtle and playful message.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.**
 

Correct paragraph: 

Body language transmits__ ideas or thoughts by certain actions, either intentionally or unintentionally. A __**wink**__ can be a way of flirting or indicating that the party is only joking. A ______ (3) ______ signifies approval, while ______ (4) ______ of the head indicates a negative reaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Clap: **an act of clapping. (ताली बजाने की क्रिया; ताली)
 
• **Nod: **an act of nodding the head. (नवाई, नगन)
 
• **Shake: **the action of shaking something or being shaken. (हिलाने या हिलाए जाने की क्रिया)
